Control parameters for nbreg()

Source: R/nbreg.R
nbreg_control.Rd

Control parameters for nbreg()

Usage

nbreg_control(
  tol = 1e-08,
  maxit = 100,
  inner_tol = 1e-10,
  inner_maxit = 100,
  theta_max = 1e+05,
  trace = FALSE
)

Arguments

tol

Outer convergence tolerance: stop when the log-likelihood changes by less than tol between two outer iterations.

maxit

Maximum number of outer iterations (one IRLS fit for \(\beta\) followed by one Newton-Raphson fit for \(\theta\)).

inner_tol

Tolerance for the inner IRLS and Newton-Raphson loops (largest absolute change in \(\beta\), or in \(\log\theta\)).

inner_maxit

Maximum number of iterations of each inner loop.

theta_max

Upper limit for \(\theta\). If the estimate reaches it, the data show no overdispersion (the Poisson limit) and a warning is given.

trace

Logical; print the log-likelihood and \(\theta\) at each outer iteration?

Value

A list of control parameters.

Examples

nbreg_control(tol = 1e-10, trace = TRUE)
#> $tol
#> [1] 1e-10
#> 
#> $maxit
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $inner_tol
#> [1] 1e-10
#> 
#> $inner_maxit
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $theta_max
#> [1] 1e+05
#> 
#> $trace
#> [1] TRUE
#>
